command:
set -eu
printf '@@ BOOT_START\n'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '@@ TIME_START\n'; date -u +%s; cat /proc/uptime
for rel in '#address-cells' '#size-cells' ranges soc/#address-cells soc/#size-cells soc/ranges soc/compatible soc/name soc/sdp_frc/reg soc/sdp_frc/reg-names soc/sdp_frc/compatible soc/sdp_frc/status; do
 f=/sys/firmware/devicetree/base/$rel
 printf '@@ PROPERTY %s\n' "$rel"
 if test -f "$f"; then
  n=$(wc -c <"$f"); test "$n" -le 4096
  printf 'BYTES %s\n' "$n"; sha256sum "$f"; base64 "$f"
 elif test -e "$f"; then printf 'NOT_REGULAR\n'; else printf 'ABSENT\n'; fi
 printf '@@ END_PROPERTY\n'
done
printf '@@ BOOT_END\n'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '@@ TIME_END\n'; date -u +%s; cat /proc/uptime
purpose: One finite passive fixed-path DT parent/resource metadata capture; no hardware register/control access.
